### Shelby Slein

Welcome to my NCAA Division 1 Volleyball analytics project! 

This website examines individual player performance from 2020 through 2026, investigating how experience level and class standing relate to scoring output, attacking efficiency, and defensive impact.

The data for this project was sourced from official [NCAA Statistics](https://stats.ncaa.org/) spanning the 2020 through 2026 seasons. You can also view and download the compiled dataset directly from the [GitHub project data repository](https://github.com/ShelbySlein/experience/blob/main/data/ncaa_d1_volleyball_2020_2026.csv).
